group.p: Payment details will be available after quotation stage.

div.p: GST Included: The journey price already contains GST. The system calculates the base price and GST amount from the total journey price.

p.em: Example: Journey Price = ₹1,000 with 5% GST Included → Base Price = ₹952.38, GST = ₹47.62, Total = ₹1,000

div.p: GST Excluded: GST will be added on top of the journey price.

p.em: Example: Journey Price = ₹1,000 with 5% GST Excluded → Base Price = ₹1,000, GST = ₹50, Total = ₹1,050
